easy: Going on forever and never ending.

ex.en: Grandma says the love of a family is eternal.
ex.ko: 할머니는 가족의 사랑은 영원하다고 말씀하신다.

easy: True for a whole group, not just one thing.

ex.en: Dog is a generic word for all kinds of dogs.
ex.ko: '개'는 모든 종류의 개를 가리키는 일반적인 말이다.

easy: Holding something very tightly in your hand.

ex.en: The monkey kept a tight grip on the branch.
ex.ko: 원숭이는 나뭇가지를 꽉 움켜쥐고 있었다.

easy: The part of a tool or object that you hold in your hand.

ex.en: The grip on my bat is wrapped in tape.
ex.ko: 내 야구 방망이의 손잡이에는 테이프가 감겨 있다.

easy: Just a few; a small number.

ex.en: Only a handful of kids stayed after the bell.
ex.ko: 종이 울린 뒤에는 몇 명의 아이들만 남았다.

easy: As much as your hand can hold.

ex.en: I grabbed a handful of popcorn.
ex.ko: 나는 팝콘 한 움큼을 집었다.

easy: In a glad and joyful way.

ex.en: The puppy ran happily around the yard.
ex.ko: 강아지가 마당을 즐겁게 뛰어다녔다.

easy: Used when something turns out lucky and good.

ex.en: Happily, the rain stopped before our picnic.
ex.ko: 다행히 소풍 전에 비가 그쳤다.

easy: Getting along well and agreeing with each other.

ex.en: The kids played together in harmony.
ex.ko: 아이들은 화목하게 함께 놀았다.

easy: Different music notes played or sung together so they sound nice.

ex.en: Our choir sings in harmony.
ex.ko: 우리 합창단은 화음을 맞춰 노래한다.

easy: When things look or sound good together.

ex.en: The colors of the flowers are in perfect harmony.
ex.ko: 꽃 색깔들이 완벽하게 조화를 이룬다.

easy: Something made by mixing two different kinds of things.

ex.en: This car is a hybrid of gas and electric power.
ex.ko: 이 차는 휘발유와 전기를 함께 쓰는 하이브리드다.

easy: A plant or animal whose parents are two different kinds.

ex.en: A mule is a hybrid of a horse and a donkey.
ex.ko: 노새는 말과 당나귀의 잡종이다.

easy: A row of keys that you press to make music or to type.

ex.en: My fingers danced across the piano keyboard.
ex.ko: 내 손가락이 피아노 건반 위를 춤추듯 움직였다.

easy: Staying for a long time.

ex.en: We made a lasting friendship at camp.
ex.ko: 우리는 캠프에서 오래가는 우정을 쌓았다.

easy: Not strong or harsh.

ex.en: We had a mild winter, so we played outside.
ex.ko: 겨울이 온화해서 우리는 밖에서 놀았다.

easy: Gentle and quiet, not loud or pushy.

ex.en: Our mild hamster never bites.
ex.ko: 우리 햄스터는 온순해서 절대 물지 않는다.

easy: Warm and nice, not too hot or too cold.

ex.en: It was a mild spring day, perfect for a picnic.
ex.ko: 소풍 가기 좋은 포근한 봄날이었다.

easy: Putting things together so they become one.

ex.en: Mixing blue and yellow paint makes green.
ex.ko: 파란색과 노란색 물감을 섞으면 초록색이 된다.

easy: Having to do with the tiny bits that everything is made of.

ex.en: We built a molecular model of water with clay balls.
ex.ko: 우리는 점토 공으로 물의 분자 모형을 만들었다.

easy: A person who lives close to you.

ex.en: My neighbor has a big friendly dog.
ex.ko: 우리 이웃집에는 크고 순한 개가 있다.

easy: A place or thing of the same kind that is right next to another.

ex.en: Canada is a neighbor of the United States.
ex.ko: 캐나다는 미국의 이웃 나라다.

easy: To live or be right next to something.

ex.en: Our school neighbors a big park.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 큰 공원과 이웃해 있다.

easy: Twelve o'clock in the daytime, the middle of the day.

ex.en: We eat lunch at noon.
ex.ko: 우리는 정오에 점심을 먹는다.

easy: The time that is happening right now.

ex.en: Let's forget the past and think about the present.
ex.ko: 지난 일은 잊고 지금을 생각하자.

easy: Without hiding anything.

ex.en: She openly told the class she was nervous.
ex.ko: 그녀는 반 친구들에게 긴장된다고 솔직하게 말했다.

easy: A short talk or writing that shows the main points.

ex.en: The teacher gave us an overview of the book.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리에게 그 책의 개요를 설명해 주셨다.

easy: So weak or poor that people feel sorry for it.

ex.en: My sandcastle looked pathetic after the wave hit it.
ex.ko: 파도가 지나간 뒤 내 모래성은 한심해 보였다.

easy: A plant with round brown roots that grow underground and are eaten as food.

ex.en: I ate a hot baked potato with butter.
ex.ko: 나는 뜨거운 구운 감자에 버터를 발라 먹었다.

easy: Liking one thing more than another.

ex.en: My preference is chocolate ice cream.
ex.ko: 내가 더 좋아하는 건 초콜릿 아이스크림이다.

easy: Likely to do well or be very good.

ex.en: The coach said I was a promising young swimmer.
ex.ko: 코치님은 내가 유망한 어린 수영 선수라고 말씀하셨다.

easy: Likely to turn out well later on.

ex.en: With so many sunny days, the garden looks promising.
ex.ko: 화창한 날이 많아서 정원이 잘 자랄 것 같다.

easy: How big one part is compared to the whole thing.

ex.en: Only a small proportion of the class walks to school.
ex.ko: 우리 반에서 걸어서 등교하는 학생은 아주 일부다.

easy: How big or wide something is.

ex.en: The whale is an animal of huge proportions.
ex.ko: 고래는 엄청난 크기의 동물이다.

easy: When all the parts of something fit together well in size.

ex.en: The drawing of the horse has good proportion.
ex.ko: 그 말 그림은 균형이 잘 잡혀 있다.

easy: A very strong angry feeling.

ex.en: He kicked the ball in a rage after losing.
ex.ko: 그는 지고 나서 화가 치밀어 공을 찼다.

easy: Being so angry that you cannot calm down.

ex.en: She was in a rage when her brother broke her toy.
ex.ko: 남동생이 장난감을 부수자 그녀는 불같이 화를 냈다.

easy: Liked and admired by many people.

ex.en: Our principal is a respected leader.
ex.ko: 우리 교장 선생님은 존경받는 분이다.

easy: Making something good or working again.

ex.en: The restoration of the old bridge took two years.
ex.ko: 낡은 다리를 복원하는 데 2년이 걸렸다.

easy: Being fixed up so it looks new or like it used to.

ex.en: The restoration of the old house made it look new again.
ex.ko: 낡은 집을 복원하자 다시 새집처럼 보였다.

easy: A soldier with a rank who gives orders to small groups of soldiers.

ex.en: The sergeant told the soldiers to line up.
ex.ko: 부사관은 군인들에게 줄을 서라고 말했다.

easy: A police officer who is the boss of other police officers.

ex.en: The police sergeant helped us cross the street.
ex.ko: 경사님이 우리가 길을 건너는 것을 도와주셨다.

easy: A special big chair where a king or queen sits.

ex.en: The little prince sat on the golden throne.
ex.ko: 어린 왕자는 황금 왕좌에 앉았다.

easy: The power and place of being a king or queen.

ex.en: The young princess will take the throne one day.
ex.ko: 어린 공주는 언젠가 왕위에 오를 것이다.

easy: To cheer for someone to do their best.

ex.en: We urged our team on with loud cheers.
ex.ko: 우리는 큰 함성으로 우리 팀을 응원했다.

easy: A person who is allowed to choose a leader in an election.

ex.en: Every voter in town lined up at the school to choose a mayor.
ex.ko: 마을의 모든 유권자들이 시장을 뽑으려고 학교에 줄을 섰다.

easy: A woman in stories who uses magic.

ex.en: The witch in the story stirred her magic pot.
ex.ko: 이야기 속 마녀가 마법의 솥을 저었다.

easy: A place or group of old papers and records that are kept safe.

ex.en: Our town keeps old photos in the archives.
ex.ko: 우리 마을은 오래된 사진들을 기록 보관소에 보관한다.

easy: The part of your body between your chest and your legs.

ex.en: My belly rumbled because I was hungry.
ex.ko: 배가 고파서 내 배에서 꼬르륵 소리가 났다.

easy: A table in a restaurant with benches that have high backs.

ex.en: We sat in a booth at the pizza place.
ex.ko: 우리는 피자 가게의 칸막이 좌석에 앉았다.

easy: A small space with walls for a special use.

ex.en: She stood in a photo booth and made silly faces.
ex.ko: 그녀는 사진 부스에 들어가 우스꽝스러운 표정을 지었다.

easy: A small stand or shop at a fair where people sell things or run games.

ex.en: We won a prize at the ring toss booth.
ex.ko: 우리는 고리 던지기 부스에서 상품을 탔다.

easy: When dead plants or animals slowly rot and fall apart.

ex.en: The breakdown of old leaves makes the soil rich.
ex.ko: 낙엽이 분해되면 흙이 기름져진다.

easy: Very mean and willing to hurt others.

ex.en: The wolf in the story was brutal to the little pigs.
ex.ko: 이야기 속 늑대는 아기 돼지들에게 잔인했다.

easy: So strong and harsh that it is hard to bear.

ex.en: The brutal summer sun made us hide in the shade.
ex.ko: 혹독한 여름 햇볕 때문에 우리는 그늘로 숨었다.

easy: When everyone in a group agrees.

ex.en: Our class reached a consensus to have pizza on Friday.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 금요일에 피자를 먹기로 의견이 일치했다.

easy: Riding a bike, often for fun or as a sport.

ex.en: Cycling to school is good exercise.
ex.ko: 자전거를 타고 학교에 가는 것은 좋은 운동이다.

easy: Something you say or write in a very clear and strong way.

ex.en: He made a declaration that he would never quit.
ex.ko: 그는 절대 포기하지 않겠다고 선언했다.

easy: Seeing how two things are not the same.

ex.en: Can you tell the distinction between a frog and a toad?
ex.ko: 개구리와 두꺼비를 구별할 수 있니?

easy: Being very well known and respected for being great at something.

ex.en: The scientist was a person of great distinction.
ex.ko: 그 과학자는 매우 명성이 높은 분이었다.

easy: A difference between two things that are alike.

ex.en: There is a big distinction between a wolf and a dog.
ex.ko: 늑대와 개는 큰 차이가 있다.

easy: Having to do with the face.

ex.en: He made a funny facial expression.
ex.ko: 그는 웃긴 얼굴 표정을 지었다.

easy: Staying loyal and true to someone.

ex.en: My dog is a faithful friend who waits for me every day.
ex.ko: 우리 개는 매일 나를 기다려 주는 충실한 친구다.

easy: Very close to the original.

ex.en: The movie is faithful to the book.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 책에 충실하다.

easy: Causing someone or something to die.

ex.en: The snake's bite can be fatal.
ex.ko: 그 뱀에게 물리면 치명적일 수 있다.

easy: A tree that grows sweet fruit with lots of tiny seeds inside.

ex.en: A fig tree grows in my grandma's yard.
ex.ko: 할머니 마당에는 무화과나무가 자란다.

easy: A soft, sweet fruit with lots of tiny seeds inside.

ex.en: I ate a sweet fig with my yogurt.
ex.ko: 나는 요거트와 함께 달콤한 무화과를 먹었다.

easy: A small part that joins bigger pieces together.

ex.en: The plumber put a new fitting on the water pipe.
ex.ko: 배관공이 수도관에 새 연결 부품을 달았다.

easy: Respected and admired by many people.

ex.en: The mayor was our honored guest at school today.
ex.ko: 오늘 시장님이 학교에 귀한 손님으로 오셨다.

easy: To want something very much.

ex.en: The lost boy hungered for his mother's hug.
ex.ko: 길 잃은 소년은 엄마의 포옹을 간절히 원했다.

easy: New and different from anything before.

ex.en: She built an innovative robot that cleans her room.
ex.ko: 그녀는 방을 청소하는 혁신적인 로봇을 만들었다.

easy: The happy sound you make when something is funny.

ex.en: Laughter filled the room when the clown fell.
ex.ko: 광대가 넘어지자 방 안이 웃음소리로 가득 찼다.

easy: A sour yellow fruit that is used to make a cold drink.

ex.en: I squeezed a lemon to make lemonade.
ex.ko: 나는 레모네이드를 만들려고 레몬을 짰다.

easy: A strong, bright yellow color.

ex.en: The baby's room was painted bright lemon.
ex.ko: 아기 방은 밝은 레몬색으로 칠해져 있었다.

easy: A small tree that grows sour yellow fruit.

ex.en: We have a lemon tree in our yard.
ex.ko: 우리 마당에는 레몬나무가 있다.

easy: Held up high in the air.

ex.en: The kids stood with lifted hands to ask questions.
ex.ko: 아이들은 질문하려고 손을 든 채 서 있었다.

easy: One of the two body parts in your chest that you use to breathe.

ex.en: Your lungs fill with air when you breathe in.
ex.ko: 숨을 들이쉬면 폐가 공기로 가득 찬다.

easy: Exactly alike.

ex.en: My sister and I wore matching shirts.
ex.ko: 언니와 나는 똑같은 셔츠를 입었다.

easy: Chosen on purpose to go well together.

ex.en: My hat and gloves are matching blue.
ex.ko: 내 모자와 장갑은 어울리는 파란색이다.

easy: Very strong.

ex.en: The mighty wind blew the tree down.
ex.ko: 강력한 바람이 나무를 쓰러뜨렸다.

easy: Having to do with money.

ex.en: The contest gave a monetary prize of ten dollars.
ex.ko: 그 대회는 10달러의 상금을 주었다.

easy: A tall tree with long needles that stays green all year.

ex.en: Pine trees stay green even in winter.
ex.ko: 소나무는 겨울에도 푸르다.

easy: Light yellow wood that comes from an evergreen tree with needles.

ex.en: Our table is made of pine.
ex.ko: 우리 식탁은 소나무 목재로 만들었다.

easy: To miss someone or want something very much.

ex.en: My dog pines for me when I am at school.
ex.ko: 내가 학교에 가 있으면 우리 개가 나를 그리워한다.

easy: The place where people go to choose their leaders.

ex.en: Mom went to the polls to vote for mayor.
ex.ko: 엄마는 시장을 뽑으러 투표소에 가셨다.

easy: A little sick.

ex.en: Grandma felt poorly, so she stayed in bed.
ex.ko: 할머니는 몸이 안 좋아서 누워 계셨다.

easy: To bring up a question or problem for others to think about.

ex.en: The teacher posed a tricky question to the class.
ex.ko: 선생님은 반 아이들에게 어려운 질문을 던지셨다.

easy: To hold still in one position, like for a picture or painting.

ex.en: We posed for a family photo at the beach.
ex.ko: 우리는 해변에서 가족사진을 찍으려고 자세를 취했다.

easy: To pretend to be someone else.

ex.en: The boy posed as a pirate on Halloween.
ex.ko: 그 소년은 핼러윈에 해적인 척했다.

easy: To make a liquid flow out of a container.

ex.en: I poured milk on my cereal.
ex.ko: 나는 시리얼에 우유를 부었다.

easy: To move out in a big crowd.

ex.en: Kids poured out of the school at the last bell.
ex.ko: 마지막 종이 울리자 아이들이 학교에서 쏟아져 나왔다.

easy: A person or company that gives people something they need.

ex.en: The farmer is our provider of fresh eggs.
ex.ko: 그 농부는 우리에게 신선한 달걀을 공급해 준다.

easy: The person who earns money to buy food and things the family needs.

ex.en: My mom is the main provider for our family.
ex.ko: 우리 엄마는 우리 가족의 생계를 책임지는 분이다.

easy: To print something in a newspaper or book for people to read.

ex.en: The school newspaper published my story.
ex.ko: 학교 신문이 내 이야기를 실었다.

easy: To make books or magazines and sell them to people.

ex.en: This company publishes children's books.
ex.ko: 이 회사는 어린이 책을 출판한다.

easy: When a writer's book or story gets printed for readers.

ex.en: My aunt published her first book last year.
ex.ko: 이모는 작년에 첫 책을 냈다.

easy: Something you pay to use for a short time.

ex.en: We drove a rental car on vacation.
ex.ko: 우리는 휴가 때 렌터카를 타고 다녔다.

easy: Having made up your mind and not giving up.

ex.en: I was resolved to finish the race.
ex.ko: 나는 경주를 끝까지 달리기로 굳게 결심했다.

easy: Fixed or answered.

ex.en: The problem was resolved when the teacher helped.
ex.ko: 선생님이 도와주시자 문제가 해결되었다.

easy: As it looks, but maybe not really true.

ex.en: The seemingly sleepy cat jumped at the mouse.
ex.ko: 겉보기에 졸려 보이던 고양이가 쥐에게 뛰어올랐다.

easy: In a strict and serious way.

ex.en: The teacher spoke severely to the noisy class.
ex.ko: 선생님은 떠드는 반 아이들에게 엄하게 말씀하셨다.

easy: In a way that causes a lot of harm.

ex.en: The storm severely damaged our fence.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 우리 집 울타리를 심하게 망가뜨렸다.

easy: A big ocean fish with sharp teeth.

ex.en: We saw a shark at the aquarium.
ex.ko: 우리는 수족관에서 상어를 보았다.

easy: In the way something is done, with the right steps and skill.

ex.en: The dancer was technically perfect, with every step right.
ex.ko: 그 무용수는 기술적으로 완벽해서 모든 동작이 정확했다.

easy: If you are very exact about the facts.

ex.en: Technically, a tomato is a fruit, not a vegetable.
ex.ko: 엄밀히 말하면 토마토는 채소가 아니라 과일이다.

easy: Having no end or limit.

ex.en: The park has unlimited space for kids to run.
ex.ko: 그 공원에는 아이들이 뛰어놀 공간이 끝없이 넓다.

easy: Never running out.

ex.en: Grandma's cookie jar seemed to have an unlimited supply.
ex.ko: 할머니의 쿠키 통에는 쿠키가 끝없이 나오는 것 같았다.

easy: Made clean with water.

ex.en: Put the washed clothes in the dryer.
ex.ko: 깨끗이 빤 옷을 건조기에 넣으렴.

easy: To tell someone about something.

ex.en: The teacher advised us that the trip was canceled.
ex.ko: 선생님은 소풍이 취소되었다고 알려 주셨다.

easy: A small flying insect that makes honey and can sting.

ex.en: A bee landed on the yellow flower.
ex.ko: 벌 한 마리가 노란 꽃에 앉았다.

easy: A gathering where people compete or work together.

ex.en: I won the school spelling bee.
ex.ko: 나는 학교 철자 맞히기 대회에서 우승했다.

easy: A small place where you can buy drinks and snacks.

ex.en: We had hot chocolate at a cafe.
ex.ko: 우리는 카페에서 핫초코를 마셨다.

easy: A farm that makes milk, cheese, and butter.

ex.en: The cows at the dairy are milked each morning.
ex.ko: 낙농장의 소들은 매일 아침 젖을 짠다.

easy: A book where you write about your day.

ex.en: I write my secrets in my diary every night.
ex.ko: 나는 매일 밤 일기장에 비밀을 쓴다.

easy: To not think the same as someone else.

ex.en: My brother and I disagree about the best pizza.
ex.ko: 형과 나는 어떤 피자가 최고인지에 대해 의견이 다르다.

easy: To suddenly go away so that no one knows where.

ex.en: My sock disappeared in the dryer again.
ex.ko: 내 양말이 또 건조기 속에서 사라졌다.

easy: To become impossible to see.

ex.en: The rainbow disappeared when the clouds came back.
ex.ko: 구름이 다시 끼자 무지개가 사라졌다.

easy: To stop being alive or around anymore.

ex.en: Dinosaurs disappeared millions of years ago.
ex.ko: 공룡은 수백만 년 전에 사라졌다.

easy: To make a round hole using a tool that spins.

ex.en: Dad drilled a hole in the board for our birdhouse.
ex.ko: 아빠는 새집을 만들려고 판자에 구멍을 뚫으셨다.

easy: To practice something again and again to learn it.

ex.en: We drill our spelling words every night.
ex.ko: 우리는 매일 밤 철자 단어를 반복해서 연습한다.

easy: Coming first in time, before the others.

ex.en: The earliest bus leaves at six in the morning.
ex.ko: 첫차는 아침 여섯 시에 출발한다.

easy: As soon as possible, with the least waiting.

ex.en: The earliest we can leave is after lunch.
ex.ko: 우리가 가장 일찍 떠날 수 있는 때는 점심 이후다.

easy: The money used in many countries in Europe.

ex.en: The bread cost two euros in Paris.
ex.ko: 파리에서 빵은 2유로였다.

easy: Making something that is broken work again.

ex.en: The fixing of the broken window took all day.
ex.ko: 깨진 창문을 고치는 데 하루 종일 걸렸다.
